title: Hopf $2$-cocycles for certain affine algebraic reductive groups
summary: Let $G$ be a reductive affine algebraic group over $\mathbb C$ with toral identity component $T$ and finite component group $K$. We describe finite indecomposable semisimple module categories over $\Rep(G)$ using equivariant data that incorporate the extension class. We prove that every fiber functor is classical and determine the image of its Hopf $2$-cocycle support in $K$ and its intersection with $T$.
